title: 1:1 prep - Samira Patel & Aaron Li - 2026-03-22
content:
Goals for this 1:1:
- Align on top account health signals and any at-risk renewals this quarter.
- Sync on escalations and support/resolution timelines (esp. CloudRetail pilot).
- Confirm next steps for two upsell plays (dedicated vs hosted pricing).
- Quick career/capacity check and blockers for you.

Agenda (30 min)
1) Quick check-in (5 min)
   - How are you feeling about workload & runway for demos this quarter?
   - Anything non-work pressing to be mindful of?

2) Account health highlights (10 min)
   - CloudRetail (pilot): usage up 28% last 2 wks, but saw 3 latency complaints (p95 spikes to ~850ms).
     * Status: Eng triage assigned (SRE + serving-runtime) — estimate next update by Fri 2026-03-24.
     * Ask Aaron: did customer accept the suggestion to try the 8-bit quantized variant for cost testing? Any pushback on quality?
   - FinServeCo (enterprise): negotiating Dedicated contract; legal asked for audit logs + KMS SLA.
     * Sales stage: legal review. Need to confirm timeline for signature (target end of month).
     * Ask Aaron: which items are blocking legal? Can we get an internal copy of the requested wording?
   - MarketInsights (mid-market): embeddings usage dropped 40% after model switch.
     * Hypothesis: SDK version mismatch; Aaron to confirm client SDK version and share logs (if available).

3) Upsell / Expansion plays (5 min)
   - Dedicated pitch for FinServeCo: emphasize predictable throughput + compliance. Confirm pricing anchor and any custom add-ons.
   - Hosted -> Dedicated conversion checklist: need lead time for capacity reservation, estimated timeline for onboarding.
   - Ask Aaron: prioritize one account for an aggressive upsell push this month? Which and why?

4) Open escalations & support sync (5 min)
   - CloudRetail latency: coordinate with Samira to set expectation email cadence.
   - Security request from HealthcareCo: awaiting security questionnaire answers from SecOps.

5) People / capacity (5 min)
   - How are demo slots? Any enablement gaps?
   - Bandwidth: are there tasks blocking your pipeline management?

Key metrics to review quickly:
- Weekly active accounts with >1M tokens: 6 (target >=8 by EOM)
- Declared at-risk renewals this quarter: 2 (FinServeCo, CloudRetail)
- Average response time for P1 tickets: 6.2h (SLO 4h)

Notes & context to bring:
- CloudRetail: customer reported p95 spikes during long-context retrievals; serving-runtime team suspects KV cache misses after long-tail prompts. Raised CON-9742 with eng.
- FinServeCo: procurement needs evidence of KMS integrations; pull PRD for Private deployment compliance features.
- MarketInsights: if SDK backward-compat issue, offer temporary support patch and schedule release.

Action items (record during 1:1) — pre-populated with owners/dates where possible:
- Aaron: confirm whether CloudRetail agreed to test the 8-bit quant variant; share customer notes by 2026-03-24.
- Samira: draft status email to CloudRetail with expected timeline and next update (coordinating with SRE) — send by 2026-03-24.
- Aaron: get Legal's redlines for FinServeCo and DM to Samira; due 2026-03-23.
- Samira: collate KMS audit language snippets and forward to FinServeCo procurement — due 2026-03-24.
- Aaron: validate MarketInsights SDK version and share logs or steps to reproduce — due 2026-03-25.
- Both: pick one high-priority upsell account and draft a 1-page play (who, ask, timeline) — draft by 2026-03-27.

Questions I want to ask Aaron:
- Which account is most receptive to a short-term discount for committing to Dedicated?
- Any friction in booking Infra team for private on-prem PoC windows?
- How are demos converting post-new-playbook? Anything I should change in the demo script?

Follow-ups after meeting (how I'll track)
- Add all action items to JIRA-CS and tag Aaron + Samira, set due dates.
- Update account notes in Salesforce with the latency incident details and next contact date.
- Re-run health dashboard for impacted accounts on Mon morning and flag any regression.

Notes to self (scratchpad):
- Bring the annotated SLA clause examples for FinServeCo (one-pager).
- Remind Aaron about headcount ask for Q3 CS hires (we should surface upstream if pipeline needs more coverage).
- If CloudRetail latency persists after quant test, propose canary to a smaller shard or temporary traffic split to hosted fallback.

End of prep. Keep this doc rough — will copy action items to JIRA after the 1:1.
